n-k-k5-01.title: Ingabe isaziso siyamsekela u-Minseo?
n-k-k5-01.goal: Hlola isimangalo somngani ngokumelene nayo yonke imibandela yesaziso, hhayi eyokuqala kuphela, bese uchaza umphumela ngesiKorea.
n-k-k5-01.material:
Isaziso sesitolo se-inthanethi nomyalezo wasemnganini wakho u-Minseo. Namuhla ngu-July 12.

[여름맞이 이벤트 안내]
- 기간: 7월 1일 ~ 7월 15일
- 이벤트 기간에 3만 원 이상 사시면 배송비가 무료입니다.
- 제주·도서산간 지역은 무료 배송 대상이 아닙니다. (배송비 3,000원)
- 할인 쿠폰은 한 번만 쓸 수 있습니다.

민서의 문자: "나 어제 4만 원어치 샀어! 배송비 무료래. 제주도에 계신 우리 할머니 댁으로 보냈는데 잘됐지?"
n-k-k5-01.prereq.1: Wazi izinombolo ezifana no-만 원 no-삼천 원
n-k-k5-01.prereq.2: Wazi ukuthi 도서산간 = amazwe asemaphethelweni ezintaba
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.prompt: Ukunquma ukuthi isimangalo sika-Minseo siyiqiniso yini, yiziphi izimugqa zesaziso okumele uziqhathanise nomyalezo wakhe? Khetha zonke ezibalulekile.
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.0: Yiziphi izigameko emyalezweni ka-Minseo isaziso esikhuluma ngazo? Funa umugqa ngesigameko ngasinye.
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.1: Emugqeni ngamunye wesaziso, buza: ingabe ubeka umbandela wokuletha mahhala?
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.a: Umthetho we-coupon umayelana nezaphulelo. Isimangalo sika-Minseo simayelana nenkokhelo yokuletha, ngakho lo mugqa awunquli.
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.explain: Isimangalo sakhe sinezingxenye ezintathu: lapho athenga khona (isikhathi somcimbi), kangakanani (u-30,000 won noma ngaphezulu) nalapho kuthunyelwe khona (umthetho wendawo). Ingxenye ngayinye ihlanganiswa ngumugqa owodwa; umugqa we-coupon awumayelani nokuletha.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.prompt: Ingabe isaziso sisekela isimangalo sika-Minseo sokuthi ukulethwa kwakhe kungamahhala?
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.hint.0: Thatha imibandela yesaziso eyodwa ngesikhathi bese uphawula ngayinye ngokumelene nomyalezo wakhe.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.hint.1: Yimuphi umbandela ongakahlolwa ngokumelene nomyalezo wakhe?
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.a: Yebo, kodwa kuphela uma naye esebenzise i-coupon yezaphulelo yesikhathi esisodwa.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.r.a: I-coupon iyisikhalazo esihlukile; akusiwo umbandela wokuletha mahhala.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.b: Akwaziwa, ngoba u-Minseo kuphela owazi ukuthi ukhokhe malini ngempela.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.r.b: Inani lisemyalezweni wakhe, futhi isaziso siqamba izifunda esizishiyayo, ngakho isinqumo siyenzeka.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.c: Yebo. Uthenge nge-40,000 won ngesikhathi somcimbi, ngakho ukulethwa kungamahhala.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.r.c: Uhlole usuku nenani, kodwa wayeka lapho. Isaziso sinomunye umbandela mayelana nalapho iphasela liya khona.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.d: Cha. Isaziso asinikezi ukulethwa mahhala endaweni ayithumele kuyo.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.explain: Ukulethwa mahhala kudinga isikhathi somcimbi NO-30,000 won noma ngaphezulu NO-ndawo yokuletha engasishiywanga. U-Minseo uhlangabezana nezimbili zokuqala, kodwa isaziso sishiya u-제주·도서산간. Ukuhlangabezana nombandela wokuqala akwenzi isimangalo siyiqiniso.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.prompt: Phendula u-Minseo ngesiKorea (ukukhuluma kwe--요 kobungane). Sho ukuthi ucabanga ini ngenkokhelo yakhe yokuletha futhi unikeze isizathu esivela esaziseni. SesiNgisi siyamukelwa uma uphelelwa.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngendawo, bese usho ukuthi isaziso senzani ngaleyo ndawo.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.hint.1: Phetha ngalokho u-Minseo okufanele akulindele ukukhokha.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ngikusekele esaziseni hhayi ekuqageleni kwami kuphela?
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.model.2: I think it's not free: the notice says Jeju is not included, so there may be a 3,000 won fee.

n-k-k5-03.title: Ukubhuka okuhambisana nayo yonke imithetho
n-k-k5-03.topic: imibandela eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa, owodwa ufihlwe emagameni
n-k-k5-03.goal: Guqula isaziso esinomthetho wokuphika sibe yimibandela eqondile, uthole ukubhuka okuningana okuhlangabezana nayo yonke, bese ubika owodwa ngesiKorea.
n-k-k5-03.material:
Ubhuka i-workshop yamnyuziyamu yomndeni wakho. Isaziso samnyuziyamu nombhalo wakho we-aunt:

[가족 체험 예약 안내]
- 요금: 어른 1명 8,000원, 어린이 1명 5,000원
- 한 번에 4명 이상 6명 이하까지 예약할 수 있습니다.
- 어른이 어린이보다 적으면 안 됩니다.
- 어린이는 1명 이상 있어야 합니다.

이모 문자: "예산은 4만 원까지예요."
n-k-k5-03.thinking.0: Ukufunda umthetho wokuphika kahle (적으면 안 되다)
n-k-k5-03.prereq.0: Wazi izinombolo, 명, 원 no-이상 / 이하
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.prompt: Isaziso sithi '어른이 어린이보다 적으면 안 됩니다.' Yikuphi ukubhuka lo mthetho owuvumelayo?
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.hint.0: Humusha umthetho ube umthetho ngabantu abadala: 'abantu abadala akumele babe ... kunezingane'.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala umthetho njengokuqhathanisa phakathi kwenani labantu abadala nenani lezingane, bese uwuhlola emacaleni lapho izinombolo ezimbili ziyahluka nalapho zilingana.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.a: Abantu abadala abaningi njengezingane ncamashi, futhi akukho okunye ukuxubana.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.a: Umthetho uvimbela kuphela abantu abadala ABAMBALWA. Abantu abadala abaningi nabo kulungile.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.b: Abantu abadala abaningi njengezingane, noma abantu abadala abaningi kunezingane.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.c: Abantu abadala abaningi kunezingane; inani elifanayo alivunyelwe.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.c: Izinombolo ezilinganayo azisona 'abantu abadala abambalwa', ngakho ziyavunyelwa.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.d: Izingane eziningi kunabantu abadala; inani elifanayo alivunyelwe.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.explain: U-'적으면 안 되다' usho 'akumele babe bambalwa'. Ngakho abantu abadala >= izingane: abantu abadala abaningi kulungile futhi inani elifanayo kulungile, kodwa abantu abadala abambalwa akulungile.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.prompt: Thola ukubhuka okuhlukene okungu-3 okulandela yonke imithetho yesaziso nohlahlo lwezimali emyalezweni. a = inani labantu abadala, c = inani lezingane.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala imithetho njengemibandela emifushane ku-a no-c ngaphambi kokuzama izinombolo.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ukubhuka okuhlukene bese uhlola ngomthetho ngamunye ngokulandelana; uma owodwa uhluleka, shintsha u-a noma u-c bese uhlola futhi.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.2: Hlola imali ekugcineni: 8,000 x a + 5,000 x c.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c1: 어린이는 1명 이상 있어야 합니다: okungenani ingane eyodwa.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c2: 어른이 어린이보다 적으면 안 됩니다: abantu abadala akumele babe bambalwa kunezingane.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c4: 6명 이하: kuze kufike abantu abangu-6 sekukonke.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c5: Isamba singaphezu kuka-40,000 won (8,000 ngomuntu omdala, 5,000 ngengane).
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.explain: Ukubhuka okuhlanu kuyahambisana: (3 abantu abadala, ingane e-1) 29,000 won; (2, 2) 26,000 won; (4, 1) 37,000 won; (3, 2) 34,000 won; (3, 3) 39,000 won. Isaziso nomyalezo kunikeza imikhawulo, hhayi i-oda elilodwa ncamashi.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha UKUBHUKA OKUNYE kwakho bese ubhala isicelo ngesiKorea (-요 enenhlonipho) kumnyuziyamu: abantu abadala abangaki, izingane ezingaki, nentengo ephelele.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Qala ngenani labantu abadala, bese izingane.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Sho isamba ekugcineni bese uphetha nge--요.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe izinombolo ziyahambisana nokubhuka okuhlanu engikwakhile?
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe isamba silungile (8,000 ngomuntu omdala + 5,000 ngengane)?

n-k-k5-02.title: U-Hayun udlulisela amazwi kathisha
n-k-k5-02.topic: ukudlulisa amazwi omunye umuntu ngaphandle kokuwaphendula
n-k-k5-02.goal: Qhathanisa umyalezo odluliselwe nowokuqala, uthole imigqa eshintshe incazelo yawo, bese uyilungisa ngamazwi adluliselwayo.
n-k-k5-02.material:
Uthisha unikeze lesi saziso ekilasini namuhla (uLwesibili). U-Hayun wayekilasini. U-민수 wayengekho futhi wambuza ukuthi uthisha wathini, ngakho u-Hayun umthumelela umbhalo ntambama efanayo. (-대 / -래 zisho 'ngizwe ukuthi ...': zidlulisa amazwi omunye umuntu. 벼룩시장 = isimakethe sezinto zakudala.)

[선생님 말씀]
"토요일 학교 벼룩시장은 비가 오면 체육관에서 합니다. 물건은 한 사람이 다섯 개까지 팔 수 있어요. 가격표는 학교에서 준비하니까 안 만들어 와도 돼요. 아침 9시 30분까지 체육관에 물건을 가져다 놓으세요. 팔고 남은 물건은 집에 가져가세요. 참가 신청서는 목요일까지 내세요."
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.prompt: Umbhalo ka-Hayun kufanele udlulisele kahle lokho uthisha akushilo. Imigqa eminingana ishintsha incazelo kathisha. Khetha owodwa kuyo.
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.hint.0: Thatha umyalezo kathisha umusho nomusho bese uthola umugqa ohambisanayo embhalweni ka-Hayun.
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ngesibhangqwana ngasinye, qhathanisa izinombolo, izinsuku nokuthi incazelo ithi 'angahle', 'kumele' noma 'akudingeki'.
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.explain: Imigqa 3, 5 no-7 ayilungile. Umugqa 3 uguqula u-'up to five' (다섯 개까지 팔 수 있어요) ube 'must sell five'. Umugqa 5 ushintsha u-9:30 ube ngu-8:30. Umugqa 7 ushintsha usuku lokugcina lusuka kuLwesine luye kuLwesihlanu. Eminye imigqa ihambisana namazwi kathisha.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.prompt: Iyiphi inguqulo yomugqa 3 edlulisela lokho uthisha akushilo ngenani lezinto?
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sho umusho kathisha ngezinto ngamazwi akho kuqala: ingabe u-five ungumkhawulo ophezulu, ophansi noma inombolo ncamashi?
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.hint.1: Hlola inketho ngayinye ngokumelene nalokho kuqonda bese uqhathanisa iziphetho (-아/어야 하다 no--(으)ㄹ 수 있다).
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.r.b: Lokhu kusho ukuthi kumele uthengise u-five ncamashi. Uthisha unikeze umkhawulo, hhayi inombolo edingekayo.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.r.c: U-이상 uguqula umkhawulo ube ophansi, okuphambene no-'up to five'.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.r.d: Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukuthengisa akuvunyelwe nhlobo; uthisha uvumele kuze kufike ku-five.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.explain: U-'다섯 개까지 팔 수 있어요' (ungathengisa kuze kufike ku-five) udluliselwa njengo-'다섯 개까지 팔 수 있대'. Umkhawulo ophezulu, ophansi nenombolo ncamashi yimiyalezo emithathu ehlukene.
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala izinguqulo ezilungisiwe zomugqa 5 (isikhathi sokuletha izinto) nomugqa 7 (usuku lokugcina lwefomu) ngesiKorea njengoba u-Hayun wayezithumela ku-민수 (ntambama efanayo, edlulisela amazwi kathisha).
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kopela izinombolo nosuku emyalezweni kathisha, hhayi embhalweni ka-Hayun.
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenzisa amazwi adluliselwayo (isibonelo -대/-래 noma -라고 했어), njengemigqa elungile.
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe imisho yami emibili iphela njengamazwi adluliselwayo (-대/-래/-라고 했어)?
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe u-민수 uzofika ngesikhathi futhi ahambise ifomu ngosuku olufanele?

n-k-k5-04.title: Yisiphi usuku lokugcina?
n-k-k5-04.goal: Funda umyalezo wokugcina ngokucophelela, khetha umbuzo oqeda lokho okufanele ukwenze, bese ubhala lowo mbuzo ngenhlonipho.
n-k-k5-04.material:
Namuhla nguMsombuluko, 11월 2일. Uthisha wakho uthumela lo myalezo ku-chat yekilasi.

선생님: "발표 자료는 금요일 전까지 메일로 보내 주세요. 파일 이름에는 이름을 꼭 써 주세요."

Uhlela ukuqeda ama-slide akho ekuseni ngoLwesihlanu.
n-k-k5-04.prereq.1: Uhlangane ne-전에 / -까지 nolimi olunenhlonipho noma olungcwele kuthisha
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.prompt: Uhlela ukuqeda ama-slide akho ekuseni ngoLwesihlanu. Ngaphambi kokunquma, ngumuphi umbuzo osiza kakhulu ukubuza uthisha?
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.hint.0: Funda umusho wesikhathi sokugcina kancane. Ngumuphi igama kuwo elingafundwa ngezindlela ezimbili?
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.hint.1: Yimiphi imibuzo eyoshintsha lokho okwenzayo ekuseni ngoLwesihlanu?
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.a: Inani lama-slide akuyona inkinga; umlayezo ushiya omunye umbuzo uvulekile.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.b: Umlayezo usukutshela kakade ukuthi ubhale ini egameni lefayela.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.d: Namuhla uMsombuluko 11월 2일, ngakho uLwesihlanu usuwaziwa kakade (11월 6일).
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.e: Lokhu kuthatha kuyinto evamile ukuthi ukuthumela ngoLwesihlanu kuvunyelwe. Yilokho kanye umlayezo oshiya kungacacile.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.explain: I-'금요일 전까지' ingasho 'kuze kube usuku olandulela uLwesihlanu' noma 'ngoLwesihlanu'. Uthisha kuphela owaziyo ukuthi yiyiphi, ngakho umbuzo osizayo ubuza ukuthi uLwesihlanu ngokwaso luyabalwa yini.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.acc.0: Uthisha ophendula 'kuze kube yisikhathi sini ngoLwesihlanu' wayeyolungisa lokhu ekusebenzeni, kodwa umbuzo awuhloli kuqala ukuthi uLwesihlanu luyabalwa yini.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umbuzo wakho kuthisha ngesiKorea (inkulumo enenhlonipho, ehlonipha). Qaphela usuku lokugcina bese usho ngokucacile ofuna ukukuqinisekisa.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.hint.0: Qaphela amagama kathisha ngosuku lokugcina, bese usho ukuthi yisiphi usuku ongaqinisekile ngaso.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.hint.1: Khuluma ku-thisha (선생님) bese uqeda nge--요 noma -ㅂ니다.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe umbuzo wami ukhombisa ukuthi ngibona ukufunda okubili okungenzeka?
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uthisha angawuphendula ngomusho owodwa omfushane?
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.prompt: Uthisha uphendula: '아, 금요일 오전 9시까지요.' Kungani kwakufanele ukubuza?
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.hint.0: Qhathanisa lokho owacabanga ngaphambi kokubuza nempendulo oyitholile.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.hint.1: Zibuze: umfundi osebenza naye oqondile ubengawufunda umlayezo ngenye indlela?
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.a: Uthisha wabhala usuku ngephutha futhi wayesho uLwesithathu.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.r.a: Akukho emlayezweni okukhomba uLwesithathu, futhi impendulo inikeza usuku lokugcina lwangoLwesihlanu.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.b: Kokubili uLwesine noLwesihlanu kwakuyizindlela zokufunda ezifanele, ngakho uthisha kuphela owayengakuxazulula.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.c: I-'전까지' ihlala ishiya usuku olubizwe, ngakho uLwesine kwakungusuku lokugcina.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.r.c: Impendulo ikhombisa ukuthi ekuseni ngoLwesihlanu kwakuvunyelwe, futhi abakhulumi abaningi basebenzisa i-'전까지' ngokukhululekile. Akuyona umthetho omisiwe.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.d: I-'까지' ihlala ifaka usuku olubizwe, ngakho uLwesihlanu lwalunikeziwe kusukela ekuqaleni.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.r.d: Uma lokho kuhlala kuyiqiniso ubengadingi mbuzo; impendulo iphinde yengeza isikhathi (오전 9시) umlayezo owawungazange uyinike.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.explain: Umusho ofanayo ungasho 'ngoLwesine' noma 'ngoLwesihlanu'. Ukuwufunda ngendlela eyodwa kuphela kwakungenzela ifayela lifike sekwephuzile. Impendulo iphinde yengeza isikhathi (오전 9시) umlayezo owawungazange uyinike.

n-k-k5-05.title: Kusuka engxoxweni yabangane kuya esazisweni se-elevator
n-k-k5-05.goal: Bhala kabusha umlayezo wengxoxo wabangaziwa ngokwengeza ulwazi abangane abahlanganyela ngalo bese ushintsha izinga lolimi.
n-k-k5-05.material:
Wena nomngane wakho nihlala nonke nibambe iphathi yokwamukela ikhaya elisha (집들이) efulethini lenu 502호 ngoMgqibelo olandelayo, 10월 24일, kusuka ku-6 kuya ku-9 p.m. Ubhale lokhu engxoxweni yabangane bakho:

"토욜 저녁에 우리집 파티함ㅋㅋ 좀 시끄러울 듯. 이해 ㄱㄱ"

(ㅋㅋ = ukuhleka, ㄱㄱ = 'hamba / kulungile', 토욜 = 토요일.) Manje ufuna ukubeka isaziso ku-elevator sabamakhelwane. Abaningi badala, futhi awuhlangananga nabaningi.
n-k-k5-05.thinking.1: Ukukhetha izinga lolimi labangaziwa bezinhlobo ezahlukene zeminyaka
n-k-k5-05.prereq.1: Uhlangane ne-양해, 죄송, 부탁 noma ungazifunda ezinkombeni
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.prompt: Abangane bayazi lapho uhlala khona nokuthi iphathi ingobani. Omakhelwane abangakaze bahlangane nawe abazi. Yiziphi izinto okufanele isaziso se-elevator sizengeze? Khetha zonke ezisebenzayo.
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.hint.0: Cabanga ufunda umlayezo wengxoxo njengomakhelwane: yini ongasayazi?
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.hint.1: Omakhelwane bangase bacasuke ngomsindo. Bangafuna ukuzwa ini kuwe?
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.o.b: Iphathi iqala nini futhi iphela nini
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.r.c: Omakhelwane abadingi imenyu ukuze baqonde isaziso.
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.explain: Omakhelwane kumele bazi ukuthi ubani ongenisa umsindo (ifulethi), isikhathi esingakanani (isikhathi sokuqala nesokuphela) nokuthi uyabahlonipha (ukuxolisa nesicelo). Imenyu nohlu lwezivakashi kuphathelene nabangane kuphela.
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.prompt: Umfundi osebenza naye wabhala umbhalo wokuqala wesaziso. Umugqa owodwa awufanele omakhelwane ongabazi, kufaka abantu abadala. Wukhethe.
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.hint.0: Funda umugqa ngamunye njengomakhelwane omdala. Muphi ozwakala sengathi uvela kumngane?
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.hint.1: Bheka ukuthi ezinye izicelo emibhalweni yokuqala zibhalwe kanjani.
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.explain: Umugqa wesi-4 ucela omakhelwane okuthile ngendlela elula, enobungane ('이해해 줘요'). Kubantu ongabazi, cela nge-'주세요 / 주시면 감사하겠습니다', isb. '이해해 주시면 감사하겠습니다'.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.prompt: Manje bhala wonke isaziso wena ngesiKorea se-elevator. Faka ifulethi lakho, izikhathi zokuqala nezokuphela, nokuxolisa noma isicelo sokuqondiswa. Sebenzisa inkulumo enenhlonipho, yesitayela sesaziso.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokubingelela nefulethi lakho, njengasesazisweni sangempela.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.hint.1: Beka amaqiniso (nini, yini) emshweni owodwa, bese ukuxolisa emshweni olandelayo.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe umakhelwane ongakaze ahlangane nami angazi ukuthi yifulethi likabani nokuthi liphela nini?
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe isicelo sami sizwakala sinenhlonipho ukumuntu omdala?
